note: The input URI authority is scanned until a path delimiter, making the bracketed IPv6 host substring input-controlled.
The computed host length is passed to the host parser for the input-controlled bracketed literal.
The bracket contents are copied into addr, preserving the attacker-controlled percent sequence near the end.
pct is set to the attacker-controlled percent sign inside the IPv6 literal.
The code indexes fixed positions after pct without first proving the percent escape and following zone identifier are long enough.
For a malformed or truncated zone escape at the end of the host, evaluating pct[3] reads at the boundary past the intended URI escape sequence.
